user.title: HomeKit Manager
user.description:
HomeKit Manager adds a **HomeKit** page to the sidebar where you pick which entities are exposed to Apple Home, no YAML needed.

Existing HomeKit bridges found: {existing}. They can be adopted later on the HomeKit page.

data.create_bridge: Create a new HomeKit bridge now

data_description.create_bridge: The bridge starts empty. You add entities on the HomeKit page and pair it with the Home app.
data_description.bridge_name: Shown in the Home app, 3 to {max_length} characters.

error.invalid_name: The name must be 3 to 25 characters long.
error.create_failed: The HomeKit bridge could not be created. Check the log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeKit Manager is already set up. Use the HomeKit page in the sidebar to add more bridges.
